# AiLunaPro

> AiLunaPro is an AI governance preparation platform: estimate-only AI readiness
> audits, an AI registry, Shadow AI signals, and indicative EU AI Act guidance.

## Public pages

- [Audit Express](https://audit.ailunapro.com/audit-express): Free, estimate-only AI readiness snapshot — automatable tasks, Shadow AI signals, an indicative EU AI Act level, and a rough ROI. No account required.
- [Global AI regulation landscape](https://audit.ailunapro.com/eu-ai-act/): Plain-language, non-exhaustive overview of AI regulation worldwide (EU AI Act plus UK, US, Canada, Brazil, China, Japan, South Korea, India, Singapore, Australia/NZ and more) and how AiLunaPro helps you prepare. Informational only, not legal advice.
- [FAQ](https://audit.ailunapro.com/faq/): Common questions about AiLunaPro — what it is, accounts, how readiness estimates work, data security, and support.

## Disclaimer

Preparation support, NOT a compliance certification, attestation, or legal advice.
